definition: A G5 location containing at least two independently meaningful structure or G6 slots.
scope_note: The exact approved scene materialization profile must prove the independently meaningful parts.
inclusion_rules: Use only when an approved Spatial profile contains at least two independently meaningful structure or G6 slots.
exclusion_rules: Exclude a locally bounded site without compound structure; classify it as spatial.g5.parcel.
title: G5 compound
